text:
Ria S.: Heads-up — need final signoff for the LangChain + Gateway joint demo + marketplace listing. Tentative public announce window: Thu 2024-04-07. Please confirm timeline.
Alex T.: Can we shift to Thu? our SI (NorthPoint) requested a blackout Wed for infra changes.
Maria C.: Demo assets mostly ready, just waiting on SI logos and co-brand guidelines.
Samir P.: Need legal on logos. @Elena (Legal) can you confirm? also pinged SigmaCloud about GPU quotas for the live demo.
Jordan L.: Marketplace listing draft here: https://internal.docs/marketplace/drafts/tooling-integration. Added a checklist and proposed SKU.
marketing-bot: Reminder: embargo starts 48h before public announce — auto-lock schedule triggered if assets + legal cleared. :calendar:
Ria S.: Quick checklist snippet I put together:
```
- Legal signoff (co-branding + SLA)
- Co-brand assets: SVG, PNG, white/colored variants
- Joint demo runbook + fallback plan
- Marketplace listing + SKU and pricing notes
- SI preinstall verification & test run
- Hardware partner quota confirmation
- Press embargo timestamp set
```
Alex T.: I can own the SI runbook. Will pair with Samir for infra verification and fallback routing.
Samir P.: SigmaCloud confirmed provisional allocation: 2x A100s reserved Wed-Thu for rehearsal + demo window. I'll request final confirmation in writing.
Maria C.: Can we get final SI logos by EOD Mon? otherwise I'll have placeholder slides.
Jordan L.: I'll hold the marketplace PR in draft state until assets land — can add a "demo-only" SKU for partner trials.
Ria S.: Elena, any blockers on legal review timeline?
Elena (Legal): I'm onboarding the artifacts now. Expect review + comments by tomorrow EOD. If logos contain third-party trademarks, will need signed co-mark use form.
Ria S.: Ops — what's the planned blackout? need to coordinate with Customer Success for any demo-impacting windows.
Alex T.: Ops scheduled maintenance Wed 09:00-11:00 UTC. We'll avoid pushing demo changes in that slot.
Samir P.: Recommend full rehearsal Tue afternoon with SI + hardware partner on conference call. Catch any infra fallbacks then.
Ben M.: Marketing can provide talking points + draft social copy. Also requesting two customer quotes for the announcement — can product ops help?
Maria C.: We'll surface a couple of pilot customer quotes; I'll follow up.
Ria S.: Action items roundup:
- Alex T.: SI runbook + pair with Samir P.
- Samir P.: Confirm hardware quotas in writing (pending)
- Maria C.: Update demo assets once logos arrive
- Jordan L.: Marketplace PR ready after assets
- Elena (Legal): Legal review + co-mark forms
- Ben M.: Talking points + social copy + secure quotes
Ria S.: Any objections to locking Thu 2024-04-07 public announce if all items clear?
Alex T.: lgtm
Maria C.: lgtm :thumbsup:
Samir P.: fine from infra side
Jordan L.: ok to proceed
Elena (Legal): no objections pending my doc comments
Ben M.: go for it — marketing will stand by
Ria S.: Great. Locking embargo: public announce Thu 2024-04-07 16:00 UTC. Dry-run (full tech rehearsal) Tue 2024-04-05 18:00 UTC — required attendance: SI PM, SigmaCloud eng, Alex, Samir, Maria, Jordan.
marketing-bot: Social queue created and held until embargo lift. :rocket:
Ria S.: Thanks everyone. I'll update the joint runbook in the shared drive and tag owners. Ping here if anything slips.
Alex T.: I'll post the SI runbook link once available.
Samir P.: I'll follow up with SigmaCloud for written confirmation and post here.
Maria C.: Will update slides and demo site after logos land.
Jordan L.: Draft marketplace PR will be ready for review after assets.
Elena (Legal): Will post review comments in the drive.
Ben M.: Sending draft talking points to #marketing in ~90m.
Ria S.: End of thread — thanks :white_check_mark:
